name: ALICE=ALICE
source:
Unchanging days, where nothing out of the ordinary happens.  Is this really happiness?

There is another me, one that says there is another world that is much more fun.

With that in mind, one day a vivid black rabbit appeared in front of me.

"Hey, you.  If you're that bored, why don't you come over here?"
"Well, but once you enter you can't return anymore."
"Kuku, but the very best excitement may await you there?"

What I replied without hesitation was...

Yes/No
translation:
日子一成不变，没有什么异常的事情发生。这真的是幸福吗？

还有另一个我，一个说还有另一个更有趣的世界的我。

就这样，有一天，一只栩栩如生的黑色兔子出现在我的面前。

“嘿，你。如果你这么无聊，为什么不来这里？”
“嗯，不过一旦进去就不能再回来了。”
“库库，但是最令人兴奋的事情可能在那里等着你？”

我毫不犹豫地回答道：

是/否
